label: Total amount from Form(s) W-2, box 1 (see instructions)
description: Form 1040 (2025), line 1a: the total of box 1 wages, tips, and other compensation across the taxpayer's Forms W-2 for tax year 2025.

published_value.explain: Line 1a is the total of box 1 wages, tips, and other compensation on your Forms W-2.

computed_zero.explain: Line 1a is zero because your Form W-2 box 1 amounts round to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a numeric zero whose lineage pins a W-2 source-set closure finding.

blocked.explain: Line 1a has no value yet. It is waiting for a Form W-2 box 1 amount or confirmation that the wage record is complete.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No value exists because the declared rule guard is false.
